steps.evidence: .env.example:1-4 (create a Clerk app for these keys); app/layout.tsx:23 wraps everything in ClerkProvider

notes: The README lists `npm i`, `yarn` and `pnpm i` as interchangeable alternatives, but the repo uses pnpm (packageManager pnpm@9.3.0, pnpm-lock.yaml v9, no other lockfile). The README's only setup route is `npx create-next-app --example`, which a fresh clone skips. It has no env or run instructions; the Clerk keys appear only in the Vercel deploy button. NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and CLERK_SECRET_KEY must hold real values from a Clerk application: @clerk/nextjs 5.6.2 (lockfile) has no keyless mode, so ClerkProvider fails at render without a publishable key. Either .env or .env.local works. The dev command comes from package.json (the README never names it). app/middleware.ts sits inside app/, so Next ignores it (harmless for startup). No Node version is stated and there is no CI.
